blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—It was like last year’s UAAP Finals again when University of the Philippines forward Jacob Bayla hounded La Salle star Jacob Cortez on Sunday. Bayla was praised for his defense against Cortez in the Season 88 Finals won by the Green Archers in three games, and not much has changed when the two matched up again for the first time this season. “He wasn’t only guarding me, he was everywhere. That energy is something you can’t teach, so I have to give credit to him for that,” Cortez said of Bayla, who helped the Fighting Maroons hack out an 80-76 […]...
